parts.name: Root
parts.description: The switch control. Renders a span with role="switch" and keeps a hidden checkbox input in sync for form integration.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the hidden input so `label[for]` can target the switch. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered root element.

props.name: name
props.description: Name submitted with the form when the switch is checked.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form when the switch is checked. Does not affect the visual state.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the hidden input with a form by id.

props.name: checked
props.description: Checked state. Two-way by default — use `bind:checked`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state, for when `checked` is not supplied.

props.name: controlledChecked
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `checked`
and only reports through `onCheckedChange`, so the parent can reject a change by
not flowing the new value back down. Off by default, because `bind:checked` —
the common case — needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called when the user toggles the switch.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Removes the switch from interaction and focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the switch focusable while preventing state changes.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the hidden input as required for form validation.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label when no visible label is associated.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the switch.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the switch is on.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the switch has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the switch is actively pressed via pointer or keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the switch is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the switch is off.

parts.name: Thumb
